Bluestaq runs an 11.5-week, paid software engineering residency for early-career developers. Residents contribute to real software backlog items, learn from engineer-mentors, and present capstone work to engineering leadership, with potential consideration for full-time Associate Software Engineer roles.

Responsibilities
From week one you'll work real backlog items on the systems our U.S. Space Force customers use every day, guided by a dedicated engineer-mentor, and you'll close out the program by presenting your capstone work directly to Bluestaq engineering leadership
You'll explore multiple technologies while contributing to impactful projects
You'll pair with experienced engineers, learn data storage solutions, front-end and back-end technologies, and cloud-based infrastructure, with structured milestones along the way: an onboarding week covering our tooling and secure development practices, a midpoint demo, and a capstone presentation

Software Development

Required
final-year associate, undergraduate, or master's students (graduating by January 2027)
recent graduates in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields
You have software development experience through coursework, personal projects, bootcamp work, or prior internships
You have experience with software development and scripting languages
You're familiar with front-end/back-end technologies, data storage solutions, and cloud platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, or MS Azure
You're capable of working in a team-centric environment
You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving
You're passionate about big data technologies and excited to work with cloud infrastructures
You have ability to obtain a security clearance
Preferred
Current clearance holders are strongly encouraged to apply
Benefits
Sick pay as per the Colorado Healthy Families & Workplaces Act (HFWA).
For full-time positions: 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision for you and your dependents.
For full-time positions: up to 6% match to 401(k) contributions with additional discretionary 4% profit share on day one; Roth options available; no vesting period.
Every role is eligible for an annual performance bonus.
For full-time positions: $200,000 employer-paid life insurance, plus short- and long-term disability coverage.
For full-time positions: $5,000 annual professional development budget per employee.
For full-time positions: 20 days PTO, plus 8 paid holidays.
For full-time positions: pet insurance, onsite gym, and flexible schedule.
Relocation assistance is available for full-time positions.
